title: The Code Of The Extraordinary Mind

questions.q: Rule 6 advises holding two versions of reality at once. What are they?
questions.why: Rule 6 is about the exciting future and the current reality.

questions.q: What term combines "bliss" and "discipline" in Rule 7?
questions.why: Vishen coined "blissipline" to describe disciplined bliss.

questions.q: Which practice helps extend the feeling of bliss after a big goal?
questions.why: Vishen recommends a disciplined gratitude practice to prolong bliss.

questions.q: Rule 9's goal is to become "unfuckwithable." What does that mean?
questions.why: Unfuckwithable means no one can stop you from achieving your dreams.

questions.q: What is a key component of becoming unfuckwithable?
questions.why: Self‑fueled goals are essential to being unfuckwithable.
